sn2.17:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Subrahmā devaputto Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn2.17:2.1: Niccam utrastam idaṃ cittaṃ || niccam ubiggam idaṃ mano || anuppannesu kiccesu || atho uppattitesu ca || sace atthi anutrastaṃ || taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito ti || ||
sn2.17:3.1: Na aññatra bojjhaṅgatapasā|| na aññatra indriyasaṃvarā|| na aññatra sabbanissaggā || sotthiṃ passāmi pāṇinanti || ||
